description.value: CodeSystem for the Patient-Reported Outcomes version of the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (PRO-CTCAE). Contains all 124 items across 78 adverse events with English primary text and German designations from the NCI-authorized translation. Item Library Version 1.0.

copyright.value: PRO-CTCAE is a product of the US National Cancer Institute (NCI). The PRO-CTCAE items, calculation algorithms, and item library are available free of charge for use in cancer clinical trials.
